description_en: Queries the call details of an outbound robocall task
description_zh: 查看指定机器人外呼任务的话单详情
name: QueryCallDetailByTaskId

parameters.description_en: The unique ID of the outbound robocall task. The task ID is returned after the outbound robocall task is successfully delivered. You can view the task ID on the [Task Management](https://dyvms.console.aliyun.com/job/list) page of the Voice Messaging Service console, or call the **BatchRobotSmartCall** operation to obtain the **task ID**.
parameters.description_zh: 机器人呼叫任务的唯一任务ID，成功下发机器人外呼任务后返回。可以在语音控制台[任务管理](https://dyvms.console.aliyun.com/job/list)中查看，或调用接口**BatchRobotSmartCall**成功后记录返回的参数**TaskId**。
parameters.help_en: The unique ID of the outbound robocall task. The task ID is returned after the outbound robocall task is successfully delivered. parameters.name: task_id

parameters.description_en: The start time of the outbound robocall task. This value is a UNIX timestamp representing the number of milliseconds that have elapsed since January 1, 1970, 00:00:00 UTC.
parameters.description_zh: 机器人外呼任务的开始时间。Unix时间戳格式，单位为毫秒。
